incidents.name: We are investigating reports of slow response times
incidents.message: DNS issues experienced by our upstream provider have been resolved and services are operating normally.

incidents.name: Network issues
incidents.message: We have resolved some DNS issues we were experiencing where some apps could not talk to their dependencies.  Services are back to normal and we will continue to monitor,

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of slow downs for Teamwork in our US region
incidents.message: A short lived bug caused unintentional amount of traffic to hit one of our databases. The change was rolled back and is being redeveloped.

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of users unable to create new accounts at teamwork.com
incidents.message: We have reverted some recently security measures we recently deployed, allowing sign ups to progress fully again.

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of slow load times for Desk in our US region
incidents.message: We have rolled back a deployment which introduced a slow down loading Desk. Desk is operating normally now.

incidents.name: we are investigating reports from users that tasks in Teamwork are not loading in our US region
incidents.message: We have directed traffic away from a number of databases that were upgraded earlier this morning during our maintenance work.

incidents.name: [Scheduled] Database maintenance for Teamwork in our US region
incidents.message: The scheduled maintenance has been completed.

incidents.name: We are investigating connection issues for Desk in our US region
incidents.message: Some maintenance being performed to a Redis cache caused Desk to respond slowly for a minute while the maintenance completed.

incidents.name: Webhooks delayed for Teamwork Desk in our US region
incidents.message: We have identified an issue in how we process a larger number of Desk webhook messages in a queue. The Desk team has deployed a fix and the full queue has processed now.

incidents.name: [Scheduled] Database maintenance US and EU regions
incidents.message: The scheduled maintenance has been completed.

incidents.name: Investigating reports of issues with Chat in the EU region
incidents.message: This incident has been resolved.

incidents.name: Connectivity issues with Chat in the US region
incidents.message: This incident has been resolved.

incidents.name: [Scheduled] Desk database maintenance
incidents.message: The scheduled maintenance has been completed.

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of users unable to view Tasks in Teamwork in our EU region
incidents.message: The team has deployed a change to fix this issue now.

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of slow response times for Chat in our US region
incidents.message: A database replica lagged for a moment causing a temporary slow down for Chat in our US region and has now recovered.

incidents.name: We are experiencing connectivity issues in the EU region.
incidents.message: This incident has been resolved.

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of users unable to login in our US region
incidents.message: A change in our routing has been deployed to fix the issue.

incidents.name: [Scheduled] Teamwork Chat database maintenance in our US region
incidents.message: The scheduled maintenance has been completed.

incidents.name: [Scheduled] Teamwork Chat database maintenance in our US region
incidents.message: The scheduled maintenance has been completed.

incidents.name: We are experiencing an issue with Teamwork Enterprise in the US region
incidents.message: This incident has been resolved.

incidents.name: We are experiencing delays of inbound emails in to Teamwork Desk due to an upstream provider
incidents.message: An issue with our provider has been resolved and email delivery has returned to a normal level.

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of users unable to log in to Teamwork Desk in our US region
incidents.message: We experienced an issue with a Redis cache node in a particular zone. We failed over to a node in another zone to restore function.

incidents.name: EU desk is down
incidents.message: This incident has been resolved.
